name: LitQA2
intro: LitQA2 是 FutureHouse 为检验科学文献检索与综合能力构建的 248 道英文多项选择题。专家从近 36 个月论文中选择必须依赖正文、不能仅凭标题或摘要回答且需要推理的发现，配制可信干扰项并经模型挑战、Google Scholar 检索与持续人工审核；评测随机打乱选项，温度 0 完整运行三次，用 GPT-4-0613 抽取字母答案，并报告准确率、精确率与正确来源 DOI 召回率。
build_method: 近期论文专家出题, 模型与检索挑战, 持续人工审核
task_type: 科学文献检索, 多项选择问答
eval_feature: 选项随机化, 信息不足选项, 三次零温运行, DOI归因
build_method_en: Expert authoring from recent papers, model and search challenge tests, continuous human review
eval_feature_en: Choice randomization, insufficient-information option, three temperature-zero runs, DOI attribution
intro_en: LitQA2 is a 248-question English multiple-choice benchmark built by FutureHouse to test retrieval and synthesis over scientific literature. Experts select findings from papers published within the previous 36 months that require main-body context and reasoning rather than the title or abstract, add plausible distractors, and subject drafts to model probes, Google Scholar searches, and continuing human review. Evaluation randomizes choices, runs the full set three times at temperature zero, uses GPT-4-0613 to extract the answer letter, and reports accuracy, precision, and correct-source DOI recall.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2409.13740 Sections 2 and 8.2. Experts and contracted authors choose papers from the previous 36 months, write questions whose answers require main-body context and reasoning rather than titles, abstracts, or direct quotations, and construct plausible distractors plus an insufficient-information option. Drafts are periodically probed with ChatGPT 3.5 or 4 with logging disabled and searched in Google Scholar; new authors' first roughly ten questions receive close calibration review, followed by ongoing author review. LitQA2 expands the original 47 LitQA questions by 100 and then 101 to reach 248. Measurement randomizes answer order per call, performs three complete temperature-zero runs, uses GPT-4-0613 to extract one answer letter, treats insufficient information as Unsure except when the ideal answer is null, and reports accuracy, answered-question precision, and correct-source DOI recall.
